description: Fork of exp593 (1.4337 SoTA). SINGLE change: v_lut tph 320 -> 512 (NAP unchanged at 6). Pure capacity addition: atoms 122K -> 196K (+60%), mixture depth 320 -> 512 (+60%), per-row gradient coverage UNCHANGED at 128 tok/row. exp602 (NAP=5 tph=512) failed +0.034 at step 1000 — possibly because halved K hurt v_lut's atom-count. exp603 keeps K=64 and just adds tables. Params: v_lut 47.19M -> 75.50M (+28.31M total). Bandwidth: v_lut 23.6 -> 37.75 Mbits trunk (+14.15). Total ~289.4M params, ~169 Mbits trunk, ~572 Mbits total. Tests whether v_lut likes more capacity at fixed K (clean win) or whether the trunk is already saturated in this direction (no progress, like exp598's qk_lut tph doubling did).
